title: KNOWN LOOT GLOWS ITS RARITY
why: His order of 2026-10-12, the graphics program (item 14, loot glow), held to his note of 2026-08-26 that a box must never tell you what it is worth before you open it. Unopened boxes keep the plain amber pulse, pixel for pixel, whatever is inside. Only loot whose contents are already known glows: a pile somebody dropped (yours or a teammate), and an opened container that still has something left in it. Those now sit in a soft disc of the rarity colour of the best thing in them, with a lit edge along the top, pulsing gently and brighter from rare up. A dropped pile shows that glow in place of the amber pulse. Caches keep their own glow. Drawing only.
now: Dropped piles and half-looted boxes glow their rarity. Unopened boxes still never tell.
